# Errors

<!-- Generated by `uv run poe gen` from src/errors.py and the raise sites in src/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every error response from the API is `{"detail": <message>, "code": <code>}`. The message is written
for a person and may change; the code is stable. Classes are defined in `src/errors.py` (plan 004, D-013).

## Classes

| Class | Status | Default code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Invalid` | 400 | `invalid_request` | The request cannot be carried out as asked. |
| `NotADocument` | 400 | `not_a_document` | A name that is not a policy document, asked to be removed as one. Safe to show. |
| `NotAllowed` | 400 | `not_allowed` | An administrative action the caller may not perform. |
| `PreferenceError` | 400 | `preference_invalid` | A preference or skill that cannot be saved as given. Safe to show. |
| `ToolError` | 400 | `operation_refused` | An operation could not be performed. The message is safe to show. |
| `UnsupportedForm` | 400 | `questionnaire_type_unsupported` | The file is not a questionnaire format this can read. |
| `SignInRequired` | 401 | `sign_in_required` | Nobody is signed in, and this needs somebody. |
| `Forbidden` | 403 | `forbidden` | Signed in, but not allowed to do this. |
| `AccessDenied` | 403 | `access_denied` | Sign-in was refused. The message is safe to show the person. |
| `NotFound` | 404 | `not_found` | Absent -- or belonging to somebody else, which is deliberately the same answer. |
| `QuestionnaireNotFound` | 404 | `questionnaire_not_found` | No such questionnaire for this person: absent, or a colleague's (TD-026). |
| `UnsupportedFile` | 415 | `unsupported_file` | A file of a type this cannot take. |
| `Unprocessable` | 422 | `unprocessable` | Understood, but cannot be used: an unreadable file, nothing to export. |
| `FormatError` | 422 | `questionnaire_unreadable` | The file is not a workbook this can read. The message is safe to show. |
| `UnsupportedDocumentError` | 422 | `document_unreadable` | Raised for a file type the app cannot read. |
| `AppError` | 500 | `internal_error` | An error the application raised on purpose, with a message safe to show. |
| `Unavailable` | 503 | `unavailable` | Something this depends on -- a model, a converter -- is not there. |
| `ExportError` | 503 | `export_unavailable` | The PDF could not be produced. |

## From the framework

| Code | Status | When |
|---|---|---|
| `route_not_found` | 404 | no route matches the path |
| `method_not_allowed` | 405 | the route exists, the method does not |
| `validation_failed` | 422 | a body or parameter does not match its model; `detail` is FastAPI's list |
| `internal_error` | 500 | anything unexpected; the detail is in the server log |
